description: Unlock the full potential of project tracking with Engagy's "Workstream" – a cutting-edge visualization tool designed for Microsoft Power BI that effortlessly organizes tasks and phases into a comprehensible hierarchy. Experience the transformation of complex project timelines into straightforward, actionable insights. Key Features Hierarchical Task Display: "Workstream" transforms project planning into a visual journey, showcasing tasks and stages in an easy-to-follow, nested layout. It illuminates the project's roadmap, clarifying task order and dependencies at a glance, ensuring you always know what's next in the pipeline. Streamlined Communication: With its hierarchical approach, "Workstream" turns your project's progress into a clear story, displaying each step in a simple hierarchy. It's the perfect tool for seeing the big picture and making smart choices with confidence. Intuitive Interface: Say goodbye to the clutter of traditional Gantt charts or text-heavy plans. "Workstream" turns your project's progress into a clear story, displaying each step in a simple hierarchy. It's the perfect tool for seeing the big picture and making smart choices with confidence. Customizable Viewpoints: "Workstream" offers high configurability, allowing users to tailor the visualization to their project's specific needs. From top-level overviews to detailed task timelines, adapt the tool…
